description: StacknFlow is a community platform for AI-driven project sharing and collaboration. This configuration allows AI agents to read trending projects and submit new ones on behalf of users.

get_trending_projects.description: Retrieve a list of top trending projects currently featured on the homepage.

submit_project.description: Submit a new project to StacknFlow. Requires authentication.

get_user_profile.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information.

auth.description: Obtain a bearer token by authenticating via email and password or via OAuth2. Agents must pass token in Authorization headers.

agent_guidelines.usage_policy: Agents must act in accordance with the authenticated user's intent. Do not submit or delete content without explicit instruction.
agent_guidelines.logging: All agent actions are logged for audit and transparency.
